device_entry.name: 电动位移台执行器
tags: 样品/探针定位与运动控制
device_entry.description: 一种用于线性或旋转定位的电动执行器/位移台，可进行初始化、回零、绝对与相对移动、位置读取和停止运动，常用于光学对准、样品定位及实验自动化扫描。
device_entry.description_en: A motorized actuator or positioning stage used for linear or rotational positioning. It supports initialization, homing, absolute and relative moves, position readback, and motion stop, and is commonly used for optical alignment, sample positioning, and automated laboratory scanning.
